message.reasoning_content:

The reference direction is indicated by the finger in image 1, pointing upper-right. The current object's facing direction is indicated by the target object in image 2, which is facing left.

The reference direction has a clockwise angle of 45 degrees. Looking at the current object, the target object has a clockwise angle of 135 degrees.

The additional clockwise rotation needed is 135 - 45 = 90 degrees.
